item.title: CVE-2024-7430 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | Application Performance Management 9.60 patch versions before IP4 are affected. This issue seems to be present throughout the application, as several endpoints or functionalities that are restricted to Admin users can be directly accessed by Regular users. The authorization method of the application can be bypassed allowing users to perform unauthorized actions to their role. The application supports different levels of access. The application performs authorization checks to keep users from accessing functionality outside of their role such as create, verify, and/or repair.
This authorization method can be bypassed. During VA testing, it was found that under the User Reports inside the Applications menu, it is possible to create links and different reports. However, the creation of custom links, Excel reports, and service reports are restricted to admin users. Hence, it is possible for regular users with the least privileges to directly access these
pages and the application allows them to further use these restricted functionalities.

item.title: CVE-2024-7431 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.4 | In Application Performance Management versions before 9.60 IP4, The application is vulnerable to cross-site scripting wherein the application does not properly validate the input parameters, allowing scripts to be injected and then executed in the context of a user’s browser. This can lead to the attacker stealing sensitive information, impersonating users, or performing actions on their behalf. Also, the application may also be vulnerable to the below attacks:
• Link Injection – This occurs when an attacker inserts a malicious link into a webpage, often in a way that makes it appear legitimate. When user clicks on the link, they may be directed to a harmful website or prompted to download malicious files.
• Frame Injection – This attack involved embedding a webpage within an invisible frame on another site, User interacts with what appears to be a legitimate site, but their actions are performed on the malicious page, potentially leading to unintended actions or data theft.

item.title: CVE-2026-125634 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | A NULL pointer dereference has been found in the acl_check_dns_host_name() and acl_validate_spn_value() functions in source4/dsdb/samdb/ldb_modules/acl.c of the Active Directory domain controller ACL module in the Samba package. The checks read the account name after a request that removes it, and they do not test that the value is present. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can update the DNS host name or service principal name of their own computer account can include a removal of sAMAccountName in that same LDAP modify. The directory process crashes. Repeating the modify keeps the directory service unavailable.

item.description:

* before 2025.09.6, * 2025.12.x before 2025.12.4 * 2026.04.x before 2026.04.4 * 2026.05.x before 2026.05.2 * 2026.06.x before 2026.06.2 * 2026.08.x before 2026.08.2 * 2026.09.x before 2026.09.2 * 2026.10.x before 2026.10.2 * 2026.11.x before 2026.11.2

item.title: CVE-2026-136703 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | A flaw was found in the Admin REST API v2 of Keycloak. This component is used by administrators to manage realm configurations, including clients. The issue occurs because the API processes a client update (PUT) request and performs payload validation before verifying if the caller has the required permissions to view or manage that specific client. By sending a request with a mismatched client ID in the body, an authenticated user without any administrative privileges can distinguish between existing and non-existing clients based on whether the server returns a 400 Bad Request or a 403 Forbidden error.
